name: Qiubei Zhuang
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Zhang Junru et al. 1999. Zhuangyu fangyan yanjiu [A Study of Zhuang Dialects] (Sichuan Minzu Chubanshe) — dialect-point phonological sketches plausibly incl. Qiubei; print-only Chinese survey, not online.

sources.citation: 蓝明生 Lan Mingsheng. 2025. 壮语语音研究的回眸与进展(2013-2024). 广西民族报 2025-06-25 p.7; and 广西民族报 bibliographic indexes 壮语文研究著述系列目录索引·语音篇 (2013-2023) 2024-07-10 and 2024年壮语文研究著述系列目录索引 2025-04-16
sources.note: Bibliographic survey: lists the four Qiubei phonology writings (Yang 2020, Zhao 2021 article + MA thesis, Zhang Ya 2021, Yang 2024) and states that Zhuang research on 连读变调、语调模式、重音、节奏等超音段特征 is 极其匮乏 (extremely scarce). No Qiubei stress statement.

sources.citation: 陆天桥 Lu Tianqiao (ed.). 壮语方言土语音频数据库 [Audio database of Zhuang dialects], 丘北土语 sub-database (phonology, wordlist, sentences, text), maonan.org, under construction (dated 2024)
sources.note: Primary data: 20 initials, finals, tones 1-6 (22 55 35 33 13 21) + 7a/7b/8a/8b checked tones with example words; 50-item wordlist, 10 sentences, one narrative; every syllable carries a full tone number, no reduced or unmarked syllables, no prose on stress. Silent.

sources.citation: Johnson, Eric C. 2010. A Sociolinguistic Introduction to the Central Taic Languages of Wenshan Prefecture, China. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2010-027. 114 pp.
sources.note: Sociolinguistic survey; Qiubei Yei Zhuang classified as Northern Taic (80% of Qiubei county Zhuang), lexical-similarity and RTT figures only; grep stress/unstressed/prominence = 0. Silent.

sources.citation: Pittayaporn, Pittayawat. 2009. The Phonology of Proto-Tai. PhD dissertation, Cornell University.
sources.note: Comparative; a 'Qiubei' data point (from Zhang et al. 1999) appears in onset/rime reflex tables (PT *ɓ>b, *ˀj>dʑ, *r>ð, *w kept as w, *ɤ:C>a:C); nothing on stress in Qiubei or any modern Zhuang variety. Silent.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2007. Change Request 2007-027 (split of [ccx]; creation of [zqe] Zhuang, Qiubei).
sources.note: Identity record only (Northern Zhuang dialect list); no phonology.

sources.citation: zh.wikipedia 丘北壮语 (phonological sketch citing 韦景云、覃晓航 2006 壮语通论, 中央民族大学出版社) and en.wikipedia 'Yei Zhuang language'
sources.note: Tertiary sketch (ultimately Zhang Junru et al. 1999 data): no palatalised onsets, long-vowel codas lost, 6 smooth + 2 checked tones; nothing about stress.

sources.citation: 杨桂丽 Yang Guili. 2024. 丘北壮语的弱化音节 [Weakened syllables in Qiubei Zhuang]. 百色学院学报 Journal of Baise University 37(2): 53-60.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.access_detail: publisher DOI, paywalled; Harvard e-access not checked
sources.note: The only dedicated prosodic description of Qiubei Zhuang; its weakened-first-syllable analysis is exactly where a statement on syllable prominence / stress would sit (the abstract already describes schwa-rhyme, level-tone presyllables).

sources.citation: 张亚 Zhang Ya. 2021. 丘北纳思壮语音系探析 [Phonology of Nasi Zhuang, Qiubei]. 品位·经典 2021(16): 54-57, 60.

sources.note: Third Qiubei point (Nasi); short phonology sketch.

sources.note: Earlier first-hand phonology of one Qiubei Zhuang point (Yuezhe township) by the same author; a 声韵调 sketch may include a note on 轻声/重音 in disyllables.

sources.citation: 韦景云, 覃晓航. 2006. 壮语通论 [A general treatise on Zhuang]. 北京: 中央民族大学出版社. ISBN 7-81108-005-2 (and 韦庆稳、覃国生 1980 壮语简志, 民族出版社).

sources.note: General Zhuang handbooks that source the Wikipedia Qiubei sketch; a Zhuang-wide statement on word stress (if one exists) would be here, though it would not be Qiubei-specific.

sources.note: The 36-point dialect survey that includes the Qiubei point; source of every secondary Qiubei sketch; its general phonology chapter is the most likely place for a Zhuang-wide 重音/轻声 statement.
